title: Horizontal velocity correct
description: Essential: Student states horizontal velocity in Bob's frame equals Alice's car speed, v_x = βc.

title: Vertical velocity correct
description: Essential: Student correctly applies relativistic velocity addition or Pythagorean relation to find v_y = c√(1 - β²).

title: Ground travel time correct
description: Essential: Student calculates time for muons to reach ground in Bob's frame as Δt = h / (c√(1 - β²)).

title: Total observed time interval
description: Important: Student accounts for light travel time to Bob's eyes, deriving Δt_total = (h/c) * (1 + β cosθ) / √(1 - β²).

title: Equates Alice and Bob times
description: Important: For part (5), student sets Alice's proper time (h/c) equal to Bob's observed time and solves for cosθ.

title: Doppler shift formula
description: Important: Student applies relativistic Doppler formula to find observed frequency f' = f √(1 - β²) / (1 + β cosθ).

title: Solves for specific angle
description: Optional: For β=1/2, student correctly computes θ ≈ 105.5° or shows understanding of the transcendental step.

title: Misapplies velocity addition
description: Pitfall: Student uses Galilean transformation for vertical velocity or incorrectly adds velocities relativistically.

title: Neglects light travel time
description: Pitfall: In part (4), student fails to include the extra time for light to travel from events to Bob's position.

title: Confuses proper and observed time
description: Pitfall: Student conflates time in Alice's frame with time measured by Bob's eyes in the equation for part (5).
